scoreMeaning: The point of the mission works; it would ship with 4 known issues that didn't work as asked and 8 items I could not check
whyThisGrade: MEDIUM because the point of the mission worked, but other things you asked for did not work or could not be checked. The point of the mission is 36 things — Reviews entry screen is the landing view…, Collection screen shows each bucket…, Builder matches the mockup… and 33 more — and all of them worked. I could not check 8 things — An unknown #mbr/<x> segment falls back…, STATUS_META.negative.shape is 'x'…, the "View" button matches the drawing… and 5 more; 5 smaller items I could not check, and they don't change the grade: The Kpi interface exposes optional previousValue…, A snapshot JSON object omitting every…, sourceDeltas reuses the existing… and 2 more — see the list.

escalations: The project's test run reported 6 failures, but all six are contamination from THIS verification walk: the walk's autosave wrote its draft (id 2026-09-20.0) and the literal string 'Number One typed this to see it carry' to data/snapshots via the dev-write bridge, and the DefaultView/snapshot-redate tests then read that real disk state — see the diffs showing '+ "insight": "Number One typed this to see it carry"' and '+ "2026-09-20.0"'. These are a test-isolation artifact (and actually prove persistence works), not a build fault. Re-run the suite on a clean checkout, or isolate the write bridge from the fixture directory.

This build's seed data has zero automatable/wired KPIs (every bucket pulled '0 values', all KPIs Carried/manual), so the wired value cells (prd-10, t-008), the Refresh-all amber box (prd-5, t-011) and the Re-collect control could not be seen live and were judged from the project's own passing tests. If the captain wants these confirmed on screen, a snapshot with wired KPIs is needed.

The start card names the next month 'August 2026' but the collect and builder screens name it 'September 2026' after the pull (also flagged by the walk's observations). Worth a look at whether the next-up month should carry unchanged from the start card into collection.
alsoChecked: The dark global theme, header nav and scorecard tabs render cleanly on every screen.
The status legend shows five distinct silhouettes (filled circle / triangle / X / hollow ring / half-circle), so the off-track marker is distinguishable by shape without relying on colour.
The Preview read-only render correctly shows 'Locked at —' without ever printing a bare 'Locked by —' line.
On the collect screen the observations noted the Cancel and Continue controls sit only ~7px apart; the Continue button's oversized icon is the more visible issue there.
summary: Captain, your rebuilt MBR builder works end to end: I walked Reviews → pull → collect → builder → preview and back, the insight completion meter climbs as you type, and the Lock-month gate correctly refuses while an insight is blank. The redesigned builder matches the mockup closely — eyebrow/title/subtitle, amber draft banner, per-KPI status selects with a colour-independent X for off-track, Carried pills, cohort deltas and manual cells are all there — and the behaviours I can't see from a screenshot (persistence, the lock/discard/unlock dialogs, wired-cell collect, the Refresh-all sweep) are covered by your own passing tests. Two caveats keep this at MEDIUM: the primary flow buttons (Pull data & start, Continue to builder, and to a lesser degree Lock month) render with oversized icons spilling out and labels wrapped onto extra lines — a real visual-parity defect — and this dataset has no wired/automatable KPIs, so I judged those cells from tests rather than sight. The suite's 6 red tests are not your build failing; they are my own walk's autosaved draft leaking into the fixtures. Ship-worthy with the button styling fixed.
